issues.title: Leads not reaching CRM
issues.problem_statement: New leads from the customer's funnel form had stopped reaching their CRM about three days earlier.

items.description: Support found that the webhook URL in the customer's webhook settings had a typo, reading crm.testfunnel.exmaple instead of crm.testfunnel.example.
evidence: The webhook URL has a typo, it says crm.testfunnel.exmaple instead of crm.testfunnel.example.

items.description: Customer corrected the webhook URL and saved it, following support's guidance, then submitted a test lead and confirmed it showed up in their CRM, so new leads are flowing again.
evidence: Yes, the test lead is showing up in my CRM now!
